sources.access_detail: a copy the project holds (available on request)
sources.note: The only Weyto material is 'Lied des Wäjt'o', a hippopotamus-hunting song in Amharic, with an ethnographic note (pp. 214-215: 'Die Wäjt'o wohnen am T'änäsee. Sie jagen auf Nilpferde.. gebrauchen einige arabische Worte'); no separate Weyto language is described. The 'Betonung' section (p. 197) concerns Amharic generally (informant Aleka Taye): accent hard to fix, level in isolation, one syllable stressed in connected speech according to sentence accent, certain suffixes attract accent. Not a Weyto statement. Google Books scan via archive.org item bub_gb_vBLgAAAAMAAJ; text layer present, no sca…
